caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box or cabinet with a decorative scalloped top edge on the front and sides. The front panel features an arched wooden door in the center, secured with two metal hinges and a latch. The box stands on four short, outward-curving legs at each corner. The exterior surfaces are adorned with intricate floral and vine patterns in red, blue, yellow, and green on a light, possibly cream-colored background. The interior and the door of the box appear to be made of a darker wood, with visible grain. The overall composition presents a three-quarters perspective, showing the front and the left side, and the artist's signature is visible in red on the lower right of the image.
title: Tabernacle (Ecclesiastical Furniture)
